# GutenKit Architecture Blueprint: 01 - System Overview & Directory Structure

## 1. Executive Summary & Philosophy

**GutenKit Blocks Addon** is a modular, high-performance WordPress Gutenberg block plugin architecture designed to bring a visual page builder experience directly into the native block editor.

### Key Architectural Pillars:
1. **Zero Frontend Bloat (Dynamic Asset Generation)**: Instead of loading massive static stylesheets for every block, styles configured by users in the Inspector controls are parsed into a normalized CSS JSON tree during editing (`blocksCSS`), saved in the block comment attributes, and compiled dynamically on the PHP side into a single optimized inline `<style>` tag or cached stylesheet via `AssetGenerator.php`.
2. **Modular Micro-Architecture for Blocks**: Every widget/block is completely self-contained within its own directory (`src/blocks/<block-name>/`), following a strict 9-file anatomy (`block.json`, `index.js`, `edit.js`, `save.js`, `settings.js`, `style.js`, `markup.js`, `editor.scss`, `style.scss`).
3. **Lazy-Loaded Inspector Panels**: Heavy settings UI components (`settings.js`) are dynamically imported via React `lazy()` inside `edit.js` only when the block is selected in the canvas.
4. **Shared Control & Helper Ecosystem**: Reusable UI controls (e.g. Color Picker, Typography, Responsive Sliders, Box Shadow) and CSS generation utilities are packaged globally (`window.GkitComponents`, `window.GkitHelpers`) so individual blocks remain lightweight.
5. **OPcache-Optimized Block Registration**: Compiles block metadata into `blocks-manifest.php` using `@wordpress/scripts`, registering 40+ blocks via `wp_register_block_metadata_collection()` in a single memory load instead of 40+ disk reads.

---

## 2. Comprehensive Directory Structure

```plaintext
gutenkit-blocks-addon/
├── gutenkit-blocks-addon.php       # [ENTRY POINT - PHP] Main plugin bootstrap file
├── composer.json                   # PHP dependencies & PSR-4 autoloading definition
├── package.json                    # Node dependencies, scripts & build pipelines
├── webpack.config.js               # Webpack configuration extending @wordpress/scripts
├── phpcs.xml                       # WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS 3.0) configuration
│
├── assets/                         # Static third-party vendor assets (CSS/JS/Fonts)
│   ├── css/                        # animate.css, swiper.css, fancybox.css, etc.
│   ├── js/                         # swiper.js, fancybox.js, goodshare.js, etc.
│   └── fonts/                      # Built-in font icons and typography assets
│
├── build/                          # Compiled distribution assets (generated by Webpack)
│   ├── blocks/                     # Compiled block scripts, styles, and block.json copies
│   │   ├── button/
│   │   │   ├── index.js
│   │   │   ├── index.asset.php
│   │   │   ├── style-index.css
│   │   │   └── block.json
│   │   └── ... (40+ blocks)
│   ├── gutenkit/                   # Global bundles (components.js, helpers.js, global.js)
│   ├── modules/                    # Compiled module entries (breakpoints, visibility, etc.)
│   ├── template-library/           # Cloud template library bundles
│   └── blocks-manifest.php         # OPcache block metadata collection manifest
│
├── includes/                       # [BACKEND CORE] PHP Namespace \Gutenkit\ (PSR-4)
│   ├── Admin/                      # WP Admin menus, dashboard, settings pages, onboarding
│   │   ├── Admin.php               # Admin page initialization and hook management
│   │   └── Api/                    # REST API controllers for dashboard and settings
│   ├── Config/                     # System configuration & registry
│   │   ├── BlockList.php           # Catalog of all available free/pro blocks
│   │   ├── Blocks.php              # Block registration and render filters
│   │   ├── ModuleList.php          # Catalog of active/inactive feature modules
│   │   ├── Modules.php             # Module loader & asset manager
│   │   ├── PostMeta.php            # Custom post meta registration
│   │   └── SettingsList.php        # Global default settings definitions
│   ├── Core/                       # Core engine services
│   │   ├── Enqueue.php             # Asset registration, enqueueing & script localization
│   │   └── ClassManager.php        # Custom Post Type for global reusable CSS classes
│   ├── Helpers/                    # PHP Utility functions
│   │   └── Utils.php               # Helper methods (device detection, options, sanitization)
│   ├── Hooks/                      # WordPress action/filter subscribers
│   │   ├── Init.php                # General hook orchestrator
│   │   └── ... (feature-specific hooks)
│   ├── Libs/                       # Standalone engine libraries
│   │   ├── AssetGenerator.php      # Dynamic CSS compiler from blocksCSS attributes
│   │   ├── FontLoadLocally.php     # Google Fonts local downloader/loader
│   │   └── UnfilteredFileSupport.php # SVG/JSON upload permissions
│   ├── Routes/                     # REST API route registrations
│   │   └── Init.php                # REST routes bootstrapper
│   └── Traits/                     # Reusable PHP traits
│       └── Singleton.php           # Singleton pattern implementation
│
├── scoped/                         # Scoped composer dependencies (PHP-Scoper)
│   └── packages/                   # Prefixed vendor libraries avoiding conflicts
│
└── src/                            # [FRONTEND CORE] ESNext React/Gutenberg source code
    ├── blocks/                     # All block source folders
    │   └── button/                 # Standard exemplary block
    │       ├── block.json          # Block schema, attributes & metadata
    │       ├── index.js            # Block client entry & registerBlockType()
    │       ├── edit.js             # Block editor canvas wrapper
    │       ├── save.js             # Block frontend static markup
    │       ├── settings.js         # Lazy-loaded InspectorControls panel
    │       ├── style.js            # Dynamic CSS rules generator
    │       ├── markup.js           # Reusable HTML/JSX rendering component
    │       ├── editor.scss         # Editor-only styling
    │       └── style.scss          # Frontend & Editor shared styling
    │
    ├── gkit-components/            # Shared UI Control components & styling helpers
    │   ├── components/             # Typography, ColorPicker, BoxShadow, Slider, etc.
    │   ├── components.js           # Bundle exporter for window.GkitComponents
    │   └── helper/                 # parseCSS, useBlockStyles, device detection, etc.
    │
    ├── global/                     # Global editor augmentations
    │   ├── index.js                # Editor initialization (categories, icons, shortcuts)
    │   ├── components.js           # Exposes GkitComponents to window
    │   └── helper.js               # Exposes GkitHelpers to window
    │
    ├── modules/                    # Feature modules (breakpoints, animations, visibility)
    │   ├── breakpoints/            # Responsive preview device switcher
    │   ├── class-manager/          # Global class selector and manager
    │   └── ...
    │
    └── styles/                     # Global common styles and third-party compatibility
```

## 3. Main Entry Points

### 3.1 PHP Backend Entry Point: `gutenkit-blocks-addon.php`
- **File**: `gutenkit-blocks-addon.php`
- **Mechanism**: Instantiates the final class `Gutenkit`.
- **Initialization Sequence**:
  1. `helper_constants()` defines directory constants (`GUTENKIT_PLUGIN_DIR`, `GUTENKIT_BLOCKS_DIR`, etc.).
  2. Requires scoped autoloader (`scoped/packages/scoper-autoload.php`) which loads PSR-4 classes under namespace `Gutenkit\`.
  3. Binds to `plugins_loaded` hook where all core singletons are instantiated.
  4. Dispatches action hooks: `gutenkit/before_init`, `gutenkit/init`, `gutenkit/after_init`.

### 3.2 JavaScript Build & Entry Point: `webpack.config.js`
- **Toolchain**: Built on top of `@wordpress/scripts`.
- **Dynamic Entry Resolution**:
  - Automatically scans `src/blocks/*/index.js` or `block.json` via `@wordpress/scripts` default entry logic.
  - Dynamically traverses `src/modules/*/` for `editor.js` and `common.js` entries.
  - Registers static core entries:
    - `"gutenkit/components"` -> `./src/global/components.js` (`window.GkitComponents`)
    - `"gutenkit/helpers"` -> `./src/global/helper.js` (`window.GkitHelpers`)
    - `"gutenkit/global"` -> `./src/global/index.js` (Editor categories, icons, filters)
    - `"gutenkit/frontend-common"` -> `./src/styles/common.scss`
    - `"admin/dashboard/index"`, `"template-library/template-library"`.
- **Path Aliases**:
  - `@` -> `src/`
  - `@components` -> `src/gkit-components/components/`
  - `@helper` -> `src/gkit-components/helper/`
  - `assets` -> `assets/`
